AmRRON (American Redoubt Radio Operators Network) and TAPRN (The American Preparedness Radio Network) is an interesting group focusing on practising communications before a disaster so that participants can get and pass information or news in the event of a disaster.

A Youtube video with an introduction of the network - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OOiZNNB61bQ

If you have a shortwave radio capable of tuning to 3.818 (or nearby to that), you can listen in to a national network of folks that practice communications preparedness. I have been listening in for a couple months and find this group of folks practical and friendly. Their website is very informative and has several articles about radio technology, current events, and resources to become more involved if you wish.

The weekly national net is Sunday at 9PM US Eastern time on or around 3.818. Listen in and see if AmRRON/TAPRN is interesting to you.
